name: E-8C Joint Surveillance Target Attack Radar System

claims.text: The U.S. Air Force historical E-8C fact sheet describes Joint STARS as an airborne battle-management, command-and-control and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance platform providing ground surveillance information.
This historical library entry is not an assertion of current E-8C operational status and is not assigned to any illustrative site scenario.
